description: List who replied to a campaign, newest first: one row per reply with the subscriber's email and name, the send they replied to, the attachment count, the reply time, and conversationId, the inbox conversation holding the reply. get_campaign_stats reports the replies count; this lists the same replies, so pagination.total matches it when get_campaign_stats is called without period, start or end. Reply text is not returned: read a reply with get_conversation using its conversationId. conversationId is null when the reply has no inbox conversation, and email is null when the subscriber has since been deleted. Results are paginated: read the returned pagination object and keep paging with page while page < totalPages.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 100 and is capped at 500 by the server.

name: list_campaign_replies

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_campaign_replies` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata: page, limit, total (replies across every page, matching the replies count from get_campaign_stats without period, start or end), and totalPages. Keep paging while page < totalPages.

replies.description: Replies, newest first. Each entry has replyId, subscriberId, email, externalId, firstName, lastName, emailSendId, conversationId, hasAttachments, attachmentCount, and receivedAt. Pass conversationId to get_conversation to read the reply. conversationId is null when the reply has no inbox conversation; email is null when the subscriber has since been deleted.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
